column1: # Quarkus signal catalog for scan.sh --framework quarkus. Tab-separated: id, category, since, scope, ERE pattern, note.
# category: removed (breaks compile/run from <since>), renamed (artifact, package or config key renamed at <since>; quarkus update
#           usually rewrites it), deprecated (warns from <since>), behavior (semantics change at <since>).
# since: dotted Quarkus stream where the change lands (3.9). scope: java (*.java), build (pom.xml, *.gradle*, gradle.properties),
# Range rule (scan.sh --framework quarkus --from F --to T): every category when F < since <= T.
# Sources: wiki Migration-Guide-<since>. Patterns are POSIX ERE without \b or \s so rg and grep -E agree.

column6: Jakarta EE 10: javax.* EE packages become jakarta.* (javax.transaction.xa and other JDK javax.* stay). quarkus update rewrites imports; check reflection strings and XML descriptors by hand
Hibernate ORM 5.6 to 6.2: API and behavior changes that the recipes do not cover. See the Hibernate ORM 5 to 6 guide and references/2.13-to-3.2.md
3.9: RESTEasy Reactive extensions renamed to quarkus-rest* and quarkus-rest-client*. quarkus update rewrites them; Maven relocations cover the old names for now
3.9: config roots quarkus.resteasy-reactive.* and quarkus.rest-client-reactive.* become quarkus.rest.* and quarkus.rest-client.*
3.24: Hibernate ORM 7.0 / Jakarta Persistence 3.2. API removals and behavior changes; see references/3.20-to-3.27.md
3.35: @Transactional REST endpoints are no longer forced onto a worker thread. A method returning Uni runs on the event loop; add @Blocking if it blocks
3.35: kafka-native Dev Services provider deprecated; use upstream-kafka-native (now the default)
3.36: TLS provider types moved to io.quarkus.tls in quarkus-tls-registry-spi; old classes are gone
3.37: Panache Next renamed to Quarkus Data (quarkus-data-hibernate). quarkus update rewrites the dependency
3.38: Host header must be a localhost name when quarkus.http.host is localhost. Behind a proxy set quarkus.http.host-validation.allowed-hosts
3.38: low-level client switched to co.elastic.clients.transport.rest5_client.low_level.Rest5Client (Apache HTTP client 5)
3.38: AMQP Dev Services image moved to quay.io/arkmq-org/arkmq-org-broker with artemis.X.Y.Z tags
3.38: FileUpload#fileName() is sanitized (path stripped) and may return null; no switch restores the old value
